explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows dopamine hydrochloride on shortage since 2017-11-06 with Baxter, Hikma, and Hospira listed as current; our three sites each have about 12–14 days on hand and the preferred alternate is HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, which is not on FDA's shortage list today but its label names no plant we could place.

sentences.text: FDA first posted the dopamine hydrochloride shortage on 2017-11-06 and as of 2026-10-21 it has been on the list for 108 months.
The current FDA shortage list includes Baxter Healthcare, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Hospira Inc. (a Pfizer Company) all with status Current.
Hikma's label names HIKMA FARMACÊUTICA (PORTUGAL) as the manufacturing plant, but the plant is not placed in our records.
Hospira's registered plant (FEI 1021343) has a history of OAI inspections in 2010 and 2011 and a Warning Letter in 2010-04-12, with the most recent inspection NAI on 2025-02-07.
Corvale East, Corvale General, and Corvale Lakeside each hold roughly 12–14 days of supply at current usage rates.
The rule‑selected alternate manufacturer is HF Acquisition Co LLC, DBA HealthFirst, which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.
Buyer should verify HealthFirst's supply reliability and confirm the manufacturing site before committing to purchase.

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-92b156.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%dopamine%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%dopamine%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-417a53.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0e499952-46c7-4172-8c70-186312e240a3', '1f306ad2-3606-4525-5a8a-ce78f426c1a2') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-ef1353.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%dopamine%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-1d78ce.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%dopamine%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-7d1c91.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%dopamine%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%inject%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-952fac.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '1025114', '1416980', '2618677') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-bdd456.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1021343', '1025114', '1416980', '2618677') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f3c17d.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1021343') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica', 'hospira')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-00c505.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('hikma farmaceutica', 'hospira', 'hikma') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%dopamine%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-8cc1cd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('639034', '732886', '740633') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-e64e2e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('00143925225', '00409582001')
